title: Software Engineer
description: <h3>About the Position</h3> <p>We’re looking for Software Engineers who want to help us design and build the systems and tools that run the firm. You’ll find Software Engineers in all parts of Jane Street, solving real problems in critical areas ranging from trading desks to our accounting team, as well as building foundational infrastructure, whether that means implementing network monitoring or risk models. </p> <p>We are big believers in functional programming and, using OCaml, a statically -typed functional programming language, as our primary tool. More recently, Python has become a vital part of Jane Street’s research and trading work, acting as the go-to language for data analysis, visualization, and machine learning. </p> <p>Beyond our own environment, we also recognize the value of open source software, leveraging it in our daily work and releasing over a million lines of our own code as open source. We’re also always looking for ways to expand open source projects, and provide ongoing support to things like Mercurial, the OCaml compiler, and the OPAM package manager. That said, we’re interested in talented engineers with experience in any language—most of us came in with little to no practical experience in OCaml before we joined.</p> <p>If you’d like to learn more, you can read about our <a href="https://blog.janestreet.com/applying-to-jane-street/">interview process</a> and meet some of our <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/get-to-know-us/">newest hires</a>.</p> <h3>About You</h3> <p>We <em>don’t</em> expect you to have a background in functional programming, OCaml, Python, finance, or any other specific field—we’re looking for smart programmers who enjoy solving interesting problems. We’re more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:</p> <ul> <li>A top-notch programmer with a love for technology</li> <li>Intellectually curious, collaborative, and eager to learn</li> <li>Humble and unafraid to ask questions and admit mistakes</li> <li>Fluent in English</li> </ul> <p>If you'd like to get an idea of what we cover in our software engineering interview process, you can visit our <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/preparing-for-a-software-engineering-interview/">interview prep page</a>.</p> <p><em>If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to ----- Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Cybersecurity Engineer: Security Operations Center (SOC)
description: <h3>About the position</h3> <p>We're looking to add a passionate Cybersecurity Engineer to our London office to help protect Jane Street’s employees, data, and infrastructure from the wilds of the internet. Our Cybersecurity Engineers are responsible for developing and using monitoring tools to guard the firm, as well as handling incident response and remediation when a threat is found.</p> <p>Our Cybersecurity team is a skilled group of programmers and security experts who are dedicated to keeping the firm safe. We consider ourselves to be tapped into developments in the broader cybersecurity space, and can tell the difference between the latest cool hack by security researchers and what actually matters in our day-to-day. In this role, you’ll carefully consider the context of our decisions as we think about the tradeoffs we’re making in our approach to resolving cybersecurity issues. We’ll expect you to apply a methodical approach to performing unstructured investigations to locate and repair the source of a security issue.</p> <p>You will also act as an ambassador of best practices to the rest of the firm. Team members understand and practice good personal cybersecurity hygiene, and are able to talk to others about it. A key component of doing well in this position is bringing everyone else along with you on the cybersecurity journey, and you should be excited to learn from your colleagues and pass that learning on to new analysts.</p> <h3>About you</h3> <ul> <li>Graduating with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field</li> <li>An avid follower of cybersecurity news</li> <li>A strong programmer who can demonstrate high potential and an aptitude for learning</li> <li>Comfortable and interested in managing your code and configs in version control, and knowledge of your editor (we don't care which though)</li> <li>Familiar with threat modeling, and able to clearly communicate your understanding of the tradeoffs we’re making to internal stakeholders</li> <li>Able to explain the cybersecurity decisions you’ve made in your own life, and how you’ve approached thinking about those decisions</li> <li>Able to adapt to changing scenarios and make challenging decisions under pressure</li> <li>Humble attitude about what you know and don’t know; not afraid to ask questions and admit mistakes</li> <li>Curious problem solver with a positive, collaborative attitude</li> <li>Fluent in English</li> </ul> <p><em>If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to ----- <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a Technical Recruiter to join our global Recruiting team. In this role, you will focus on hiring engineers across our Trading Technology (live trading environment) and Research & Development (enabling research) engineering teams. You will partner directly with hiring managers who have incredibly high standards, helping them navigate a competitive talent landscape. You will engage with deeply technical candidates, and manage the end-to-end hiring process for a variety of technical roles within HRT’s engineering ecosystem. </p> <p>HRT is one of the top quantitative trading firms in the world. We combine world-class engineering and scientific rigor with a low-ego, collaborative culture. Our people and our compute capabilities are our two most important differentiators, and that is where we are investing the most. We want recruiters who bring a unique perspective and curiosity, who can challenge the status quo of how to find the brilliant yet humble technical talent that make HRT so special. </p> title: Software Engineer - Distributed Compute
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is one of the top algorithmic trading companies in the world. Our research cluster is the backbone of our success; it’s where all of our trading strategies are generated.</p> <p>We use a large, customized research environment with highly advanced CPU and GPU compute, storage, and networking technology. Our team thinks about the entire software stack, from the user-level API to optimizing performance out of low-level caching. We deal with everything from the theoretical, like fair resource scheduling, to the concrete, like optimizing a trader’s new program run-time performance. </p> <p>As a distributed compute engineer in a user-facing environment, you’ll develop and improve on technical solutions that make research as easy and efficient as possible. You’ll work everyday with both talented quantitative traders and software engineers across all trading teams.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensure HRT’s research environment is best in class, with a focus on user workloads</li> <ul> <li>Maintain and improve resource scheduling, data caching, and job monitoring to make research as easy, fast, and efficient as possible, using both in-house and open source solutions</li> <li>Optimize workloads at the user level to speed up user iteration speed</li> <li>Tune workloads at the infrastructure level to make them more resource-efficient</li> <li>Share metrics and real-time information with users to give insight into workload behavior</li> <li>Sit down with users to understand their specific technical needs</li> </ul> <li>Contribute individually and through leadership and coordination of the above</li> <li>Set technical direction for the platform and take holistic ownership of the software infrastructure that supports Algo research</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field</li> <li>Strong C++ expertise (daily use preferred)</li> <li>Python familiarity preferred</li> <li>Experience collaborating closely with quantitative researchers and traders to understand their needs</li> <li>Great communication capabilities</li> <li>Superior design, debugging, and problem solving skills</li> <li>Knowledge of UNIX operating systems (we use Linux), system/processor performance, and network communication</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). title: Software Engineer – C++
description:
<p>At Hudson River Trading (HRT), C++ is at the center of our live trading systems and research infrastructure. Our C++ engineers build the highly performant, fault-tolerant systems that power trading across global markets. HRT’s distributed system is on the Pareto frontier of latency and throughput, giving you limitless opportunity to leverage your deep knowledge of C++, OS internals, CPU architecture, and networking hardware and protocols. You’ll work side-by-side with researchers, traders, and hardware specialists, implementing solutions where every microsecond matters.</p> <p>Our bottom-up approach to projects and our highly collaborative environment empower talented engineers to make significant contributions and see their impact daily. At HRT, you'll be challenged to solve complex problems in a fast-paced, highly competitive industry, surrounded by some of the brightest minds in the field.</p> <p>C++ Engineers at HRT work on a wide variety of projects. Examples include: </p> <ul> <li>Develop and optimize infrastructure for market data, order entry and execution logic, spanning tens of asset classes including options, equities, futures, crypto, and fixed income. </li> <li>Design fault-tolerant, low-latency systems for live trading, including encoding/prioritization of data over WAN links and recovery from hardware failures.</li> <li>Profile and improve performance-critical code for both throughput and latency in production environments.</li> <li>Build and maintain infrastructure that drives products including client-facing wholesale and SDP platforms, distributed network filesystems, and scalable research workflows.</li> <li>Write software that interfaces with specialized hardware such as FPGAs and ASICs used in trading systems.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profile</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re one of the top devs in your current organization, as measured by productivity, technical capability, and helpfulness to other devs.</li> <li>You title: Research Engineer
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is a quantitative trading firm at the forefront of technological innovation. We build and deploy cutting-edge systems within one of the world’s most advanced computing environments to power our global trading operations. Our non-siloed, collaborative coding environment empowers talented engineers to make significant contributions and see their impact daily. At HRT, you'll be challenged to solve the most complex problems in trading alongside many of the brightest minds in the field.</p> <p>We are seeking highly motivated and skilled <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Research Engineers</span> who will work very closely with our Algo Developer (Quant Research) trading teams. These roles require exceptional programming fundamentals, a strong user focus, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with constantly evolving requirements. Multitasking and context switching are inherent aspects of this role, through which you will gain insight into the ideation and execution of some of the world's most sophisticated trading strategies.  </p> <p>Research Engineers at HRT work on a wide variety of projects. Examples include:</p> <ul> <li>Designing highly customized quantitative systems that enable Algo Developers to easily express and backtest new predictive signals.</li> <li>Building world-class research tooling to speed up Algo Developers’ research iteration.</li> <li>Aiding the development and deployment of very large deep learning models for HRT’s live trading.</li> <li>Improving HRT’s monetization systems which turn our predictions into profitable trades.</li> <li>Evaluating sim vs. live differences to improve the fidelity of our simulations.</li> <li>Building systems to monitor and manage live trading.</li> <li>Specializing in specific time horizons, from high frequency trading to mid-to-low frequency hedge fund-style strategies.</li> <li>Working across a very wide variety of asset classes (from equities to fixed income to options) and regions (from North America to Asia Pacific) – you’ll interact with markets across the world!</li> </ul> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, develop, and maintain robust, performant, and scalable software systems.</li> <li>Optimize existing codebases for performance, reliability, and efficiency.</li> <li>Debug complex issues across distributed systems in a time-sensitive environment.</li> <li>Optimize both the mechanics and ergonomics of Algo Developer research workflows; this requires developing a deep intuition for research methodologies.</li> <li>Balance the short term goals of individual trading teams with the longer term goals of HRT’s generalized trading platforms across trading teams. Because we don’t work in a pod environment, REs on different trading teams are expected to share technology and ideas.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. If you are currently pursuing your Bachelor's degree, please apply to our Campus/New Grad opportunities.</li> <li>Previous experience at a top-tier finance <em>or</em> technology company with an excellent track record of rapid advancement and superlative reviews.</li> <li>Experience with supporting internal users is preferred; bonus if you have <em>real</em> hands-on experience with quant research and/or ML/Deep Learning platforms.</li> <li>Experience with python numerical, ML and data-oriented libraries is a big plus (e.g. pandas, scikit, pytorch, etc.)</li> <li>Candidates should be prepared for technical interviews in either Python or C++. While there is no hard language requirement for RE roles, proficiency in one of these languages will be assessed during the interview process.</li> <li>Kindness and empathy is a real requirement. No “smart jerks” at HRT. </li> <li>Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and design principles.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.</li> <li>HRT ships every day. The ability to thoughtfully, methodically, and reliably deploy new software and features is a critical skill. </li> <li>If you have management experience, that’s always a bonus – but even so, expect to code!</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). title: Fullstack Developer
description:
<p>Fullstack Developers at HRT work either on our platform team (i.e. you work on infrastructure & tooling that supports all of our research & trading capabilities) or our acceleration team (i.e. you are aligned with a specific algo research & trading team). All of our Fullstack Developers have internal customers and deeply understand end-user needs. They build backend processes to ingest and transform vast quantities of data, and UIs to visualize and action that data quickly. </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Work on our in-house distributed-compute framework designed for execution on a large scale within HRT’s compute cluster. This framework serves various teams, with our algo teams being the primary users, particularly for training complex models.</li> <li>Work closely with our Algo Developers and traders, building backend processes and UIs for them to oversee trading processes, execute manual trades, assess risk, and research improvements to our strategies.</li> <li>Work closely with a variety of senior technical and non-technical users and own projects end-to-end, from inception to gathering and refining requirements, forming and executing a structured plan, and managing ongoing support and iterations to the initial plan.  </li> <li>Architect web-based tooling to provide insights and enable real-time actions using financial data, operational data, trading activity, and more using React and Python.</li> </ul> <p>The interview process will evaluate your backend programming skills (primarily Python), and your experience working in JavaScript/TypeScript on a modern web framework (React skills are required!). It is important that you are excited about and comfortable with working on both sides of the stack. All fullstack candidates will go through the same assessment & two technical phone interviews. We will start team alignment discussions if (when!) you get to onsite. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Level Up Your Career with Zynga!</strong></p> <p>At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.</p> <p>From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. reviews, QBRs, and industry events, and negotiate co-marketing and joint business plans.</li> </ul> <p><em>Performance Optimization</em></p> <ul> <li>Lead store listing experimentation (Custom Product Pages, Product Page Optimization, Google Play store listing experiments) to improve conversion rate.</li> <li>Own keyword and metadata optimization, and build rigorous test roadmaps across icons, screenshots, preview videos, and descriptions.</li> <li>Establish measurement frameworks to attribute organic uplift and quantify the impact of ASO and featuring initiatives.</li> </ul> <p><em>Team & prioritization, and cross-team alignment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>6–10+ years of ASO or mobile organic growth experience in free-to-play, ideally in gaming.</li> <li>Proven track record of improving organic installs and store conversion at scale across multiple markets.</li> <li>Established working relationships with platform partner teams (Apple, Google, and title: Motor Claims Intervention Handler
description: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we need a Motor Claims Intervention Handler to join our Claims UK team. The main objective of this role is to contact non-fault third parties immediately following an accident to offer direct services—such as replacement vehicles, vehicle repair, or personal injury management—before the third party instructs a credit hire company or solicitor. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details What you'll do 1. Proactive Third-Party Capture & Negotiation Review incoming first-notification-of-loss (FNOL) claims daily to identify actionable third-party capture opportunities. Make immediate outbound contact with third parties (via telephone, SMS, or email) to offer company-backed repair services and mobility solutions. Negotiate direct settlements for vehicle damage, minor injury, and loss of use while maintaining cost-control benchmarks. 2. Liability & Coverage Assessment Review accident details, police reports, dashcam footage, and policy terms to quickly determine liability percentage and fault. Determine when full liability should be admitted to secure third-party capture versus when liability should be repudiated or split. 3. Cost Mitigation & Credit Hire Prevention Actively monitor and challenge third-party credit hire, credit repair, and storage costs. Ensure all mitigation offers conform to relevant industry frameworks (such as the ABI General Terms of Agreement - GTA). Instruct approved repair networks, engineers, and hire suppliers quickly to minimize hire duration. 4. File Management & Compliance Maintain accurate, up-to-date claim notes and financial reserves on the claims management system. Ensure all communications and settlements comply with regulatory bodies (FCA, PRA, Data Protection/GDPR). Recognize indicators of potential fraud or exaggerated claims and escalate them to the Counter-Fraud / Special Investigation Unit (SIU). What we’re looking for 1 - 3+ years in motor claims handling (First-Notification-of-Loss, Third-Party Claims, or Credit Hire mitigation preferred). A-Levels or Cert CII (Chartered Insurance Institute) qualification is desirable. Strong telephone presence with the ability to build rapport quickly and convince non-fault drivers to accept direct services. Understanding of motor liability, negligence, the Road Traffic Act, and credit hire principles/case law. Clear understanding of claim indemnity spend and financial indemnity principles. Ability to handle stressed or hostile callers with tact and professionalism. Capacity to manage a high-volume desk with rapid SLAs for outbound contact. Why you’ll love it here: We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy hybrid working, with a mix of home and office days. 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. Think you’re a match? Apply now. At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives. Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Sales Account Executive, Fixed Term Contract
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. We help people start, run and grow their businesses with simple, transparent banking and tools that reduce financial admin, so they can spend more time focusing on what matters most.</p> <p>We're launching Monzo Business in Spain, initially focusing on sole traders and simple micro-businesses. While many customers will use a self-serve journey, we know there are moments where speaking to a real person can make all the difference.</p> <p>As our founding Spanish Sales Account Executive, you'll be based in London as part of our UK Sales team, and working closely with Spain Go-To-Market, Product and Marketing teams. You'll combine hands-on sales with gathering customer insight — helping potential customers move forward while shaping the playbook for how Sales can best support our growth in Spain.</p> <p>This is more than just a traditional Sales AE role focused solely on sales conversion. You will also have the opportunity to test, learn and influence how we build a safe, effective and scalable sales motion for Spain from the ground up.</p> <p><br><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engage with prospective Spanish SMB customers through discovery calls, emails and messaging, and understand their business, challenges, goals and requirements.</li> <li>Be a product expert: fully understand Monzo's business banking products, features and services. Explaining Monzo Business's proposition, product capabilities and application process clearly, helping customers understand their next step without providing financial, tax, legal or regulatory advice.</li> <li>Drive full sales cycle, from early prospecting and qualification; to demos and sales;  to ensuring successful account switch and activation. Drive activation: not just closing, but ensuring new business customers are fully set up and onboarded.</li> <li>Understand and capture detailed customer objections and feedback. Turn customer conversations into structured and actionable learnings and insights by identifying recurring questions, unmet needs, and journey friction and more.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Go To Market, Product and Marketing teams by collecting, analysing and sharing sales feedback to help teams make rapid and data-driven adjustments</li> <li>Manage a pipeline of leads with strong attention to data hygiene: timely follow-ups, accurate forecasting, deal tracking. Qualifying and prioritising opportunities, handling objections and following up consistently to help customers progress through their journey.</li> <li>Helping shape our Spain sales playbook, including messaging, qualification, objection handling, scripts and customer journeys. Help create and refine Spanish-language scripts, FAQs, objection handling and sales processes.</li> <li>Deliver outstanding service at every touchpoint: via phone, video, email, text or digital channels.</li> <li>Achieve sales targets: conversion, activations, revenue, engagement and other growth metrics as set by the commercial leadership.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have hands-on sales experience, ideally as an Account Executive, Sales Development Representative or Business Development Representative, and are comfortable qualifying opportunities, handling objections and following up with customers.</li> <li>Strong familiarity with Spanish culture, customer expectations and communication styles, and the judgement to adapt your approach accordingly.</li> <li>Fluent Spanish and English, with excellent written and verbal communication in both languages.</li> <li>Strong consultative communication skills: you listen carefully, ask thoughtful questions and explain complex topics simply.</li> <li>Ability to build trust with customers who may be unfamiliar with Monzo or uncertain about changing their banking setup.</li> <li>You have experience gathering, structuring and analysing commercial or customer data. You enjoy working cross-functionally and can turn what you're hearing from customers into useful insights for teams such as Product, Marketing, Operations, Risk and Compliance.</li> <li>You have experience selling to or supporting small businesses, ideally within financial services, SaaS or another complex service environment.</li> <li>You're excited by experimentation and comfortable working in an early-stage, fast-changing environment where you'll help shape processes and playbooks as well as follow them.</li> <li>You're highly organised, comfortable working with CRM tools or structured customer data, and bring strong judgement, integrity and customer care to every interaction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points if you have experience with:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Selling to or supporting Spanish sole traders, micro-businesses or SMEs.</li> <li>Banking, payments or another regulated industry.</li> <li>Selling a new and unfamiliar product to market</li> <li>Customer research, voice-of-customer programmes, sales enablement or GTM experimentation.</li> <li>Background in consultative services. </li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£67,000 Total OTE (base salary + commission)</p> <p>📍This role can based in our London office or remotely in the UK</p> <p>ℹ️ Please note this will be a 12 month fixed-term-contract</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>20 min recruiter call</li> <li>30 min call with the Hiring Manager</li> <li>Take home task and in person task review</li> <li>45 min behavioural interview</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-OS1</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. title: Operations Manager (London)
description: Working hours: Mon - Fri Location: 100% on-site in Hatton Garden, London About Nivoda 🚀 Nivoda is on a mission to transform the $350 billion global jewelry industry. We're building the operating system for the industry — a marketplace that connects diamond and gemstone suppliers directly with retailers, giving both sides a faster, more transparent, and more efficient way to trade. Today, Nivoda processes over $300M in annual transactions and continues to grow at an extraordinary pace, with teams based in London, New York, Hong Kong, Mumbai, and beyond. Our Mission 🎯 Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them. About the Role 🤔 We're looking for a highly proactive, operationally sharp, people-first Operations Manager to lead fulfilment performance at our UK hub. You'll set clear expectations, enforce standards, and drive accountability across intake, QC, shipping, and returns while building strong relationships with key suppliers, partners, and carriers. This is a hands-on, full-accountability role: you'll own performance and culture within the hub, build on an already-established foundation, and mentor a dynamic, fast-growing team. It bridges execution with team development, and calls for strong operational judgment, structured thinking, and comfort in a fast-evolving, high-growth environment. What will you be doing? 😎 Own UK Hub Logistics & Fulfilment Performance Take full ownership of fulfilment operational KPIs across the UK hub: speed, accuracy, and service levels Own end-to-end performance across intake, QC, shipping, and returns, ensuring adherence to service-level commitments Drive daily execution across the team while maintaining a strong focus on scalability and process robustness Review weekly operational metrics by function (intake, QC, shipping, returns, express) and implement improvements Maintain strong local relationships with suppliers, runners, carriers, and other local partners Build & Scale New Workflows Lead the rollout and optimisation of new & existing fulfilment streams for UK Identify bottlenecks and implement process improvements to increase throughput and reduce errors Lead & Develop the Team Manage, coach, and develop a team of 3 across intake, QC, shipping, and returns Run regular team check-ins and structured performance conversations, setting clear expectations and giving direct feedback Cultivate a team culture rooted in accountability, precision, clarity, and growth Cross-Functional & Cross-Hub Ownership Act as the primary interface between UK fulfilment, customer support, supplier teams, and global stakeholders Partner with other Nivoda hubs for cross-hub alignment and contribute insights in WBRs What do we need from you? 💪 6 - 8 years in operations, fulfillment, logistics-based office management or within the diamond, gemstone, or luxury goods industry Extensive experience directly managing people or leading teams Demonstrated ability to execute and enforce daily operational workflows Clear, effective communication skills and a highly organised approach Desire and ability to work in a fast-growing company where processes change continuously Nice to have ✨ Proficiency in Excel/Sheets GIA or Gem A qualification is highly desirable Prior exposure to or experience in diamond or gemstone quality control is also highly desirable. Our culture and what we offer 😉 At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda's success and scalability. Our current benefits 🕰️ A vibrant company culture 🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning 🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase Equal Opportunity Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts - don't let it stop you. We are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable. Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international. We kindly ask you to submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly. This is a full time, permanent position that's 100% on-site in London, UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer sponsorship at this time. Not quite the right fit? If after reading this job description you believe this is not the best fit for you, we'd encourage you to join our Nivoda Talent Pool so we can keep you in mind as new roles open up. title: Head of Sales | Fund Administration | VC & PE | Private Markets
description: bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you. Your Role As Head of Sales at bunch, you will strengthen, lead and scale our sales team across key European markets — UK, Luxembourg and Germany. Reporting directly to the Co-Founder, you will turn our high-touch executive commercial motion into a structured, repeatable sales engine across our key European markets. You will lead Account Executives and Commercial Associates selling to sophisticated decision-makers across VC, PE, and alternative asset managers (GPs, CFOs, COOs, and Fund Ops teams). Because our business model combines scalable SaaS capabilities with high-touch fund services, sales cycles are relationship-driven, multi-stakeholder, and often long. This role demands a leader who can combine structured organisation and process building, relentless deal execution and strong coaching with domain adaptability. You will: Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives across UK, Luxembourg and Germany. Set a high bar for sales quality, customer understanding, pipeline discipline, commercial judgment, and performance Define and execute market-by-market sales plans in close partnership with the leadership team Build a predictable sales operating cadence across pipeline reviews, forecasting, deal inspection, CRM discipline, and conversion tracking Set up scalable sales processes across the full funnel — from lead routing, qualification, discovery, mutual action plans, pricing, proposal creation, negotiation, handover, and post-sale feedback loops Own the commercial operating system: CRM hygiene, reporting, dashboarding, pipeline definitions, stage exit criteria, forecasting methodology, activity tracking, and tooling adoption Create and maintain sales handbooks, enablement materials, talk tracks, qualification guides, objection-handling resources, market playbooks, and deal review templates so the team has a clear source of truth Coach the team on complex enterprise sales: discovery, qualification, stakeholder mapping, business-case building, negotiation, pricing, executive communication, and multi-threading Build a regular coaching rhythm through call reviews, deal reviews, pipeline inspection, 1:1s, performance feedback, and structured development plans Stay close to strategic deals where customer trust, market context, executive engagement, or commercial judgment are critical Partner closely with other teams, including Marketing, Customer Success, Product Development, Operations, Legal & Finance, and our Co-Founders to advance commercial outcomes Bring structured market feedback into company planning, including customer needs, competitor patterns, pricing insights, product gaps, and operational blockers Partner with Talent Acquisition to hire, onboard, ramp, and manage performance as the sales team expands About you You have proven experience navigating commercial models that blend scalable software/SaaS with high-touch services, implementation, or customer operations, understanding how to price, position, and transition complex deals without eroding margins. Extensive B2B commercial experience with proven success closing complex, consultative enterprise software or tech-enabled service deals. Direct experience selling into venture capital, private equity, asset management, or fund services is a strong plus, but your ability to build a high-performing tech sales motion comes first. description: Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Luxembourg office. About us Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance . That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. Acting as a regulator-approved key executive, your role involves aligning ambitious group-wide corporate goals with the demands of banking compliance, managing the local balance sheet, and safeguarding the entity's capital adequacy. You will lead the entity's scalable Finance function, including statutory reporting, financial control, audit coordination, finance operations, and integration with the Group Finance organisation to support Satispay's growth and regulatory evolution. title: Product Designer
description: At Base360.ai , we believe running a short-term rental company should feel effortless. Our mission is ambitious: enable anyone to launch, operate and scale a short-term rental business on AI autopilot. Born from the technology powering The Flex, Base360 brings property management, guest communications, bookings, cleaning, maintenance and finance into one platform. We’re looking for a highly ambitious UX/UI Product Designer who wants to turn complex operations into simple, beautiful experiences. You’ll work directly with the founders and engineers to design products that solve real problems for property managers, operational teams and guests. If you’re excited by thoughtful UX, exceptional interfaces, AI agents and building products from the ground up, we want to meet you. What You’ll Design As a UX/UI Product Designer, you’ll help shape every touchpoint of Base360—from the first website visit to the workflows operators rely on every day. Core product experiences: Design dashboards and workflows for reservations, properties, guest communications, cleaning, maintenance and finance. AI interactions: Make it easy to configure AI agents, understand their actions, review decisions and step in when needed. Onboarding and setup: Help operators connect their channels, add properties and get value from the platform quickly. Booking and guest journeys: Create smooth experiences for direct bookings, check-in, extensions and upsells. Our design system: Build reusable components and consistent interaction patterns that keep the platform coherent as it grows. Website and marketing assets: Design landing pages, feature visuals and launch assets that make the product’s value clear. What You’ll Do Own design from problem definition and user research through to prototypes, final interfaces and implementation reviews. Speak with operators and internal teams to understand how they work and where they struggle. Turn complex requirements into clear user journeys, wireframes and polished interfaces. Work closely with engineers to deliver designs that account for real data, edge cases and technical constraints. Test ideas early, incorporate feedback and improve experiences after launch. Use AI tools to accelerate exploration and production while maintaining a high standard of design. Take initiative: identify problems, propose solutions and drive them through to completion. What We’re Looking For A strong portfolio demonstrating both UX thinking and excellent visual design. Experience designing SaaS products, dashboards or applications with complex workflows. Strong Figma skills, including auto layout, components, design systems and interactive prototyping. Excellent judgement in typography, spacing, hierarchy, colour and responsive design. The ability to simplify complex information without hiding what users need. Experience working directly with engineers and seeing designs through to production. Clear communication and the ability to explain your decisions and respond constructively to feedback. High ownership, attention to detail and the ability to move forward when requirements are still evolving. Experience with short-term rentals, hospitality, AI products, conversion optimisation or front-end development is a plus. Why Join Us Make a visible impact. Design experiences that directly influence how short-term rental businesses operate. Build with real users. Get access to the operational teams behind The Flex and learn from their daily challenges. Work directly with the founders. Help shape product decisions and design direction from an early stage. Own what you build. Take meaningful responsibility across discovery, design and delivery. Push beyond conventional software. Help define how people work alongside AI agents. Grow with the company. Take on broader responsibility as the product and design function expand. You Should NOT Apply If You're looking for a predictable corporate role with a fixed playbook. You engage in office politics or gossip instead of communicating directly. You're looking for a slow-paced role with limited ownership. You don't aim to become one of the best at what you do. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Sr. Counsel - Regulatory
description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Our Regulatory Legal team is the group responsible for maintaining and growing Kraken’s product offerings across the EU and UK and for advising the business on its day-to-day regulatory obligations. We’re a tight, experienced group of lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech, and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious, and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice – partnering directly with Compliance, Product, and senior leadership to keep our licensed entities running smoothly and our regulators well served. The Senior Counsel role is a remote role based in the UK or the EU, and will report into the EU/UK Regulatory Legal team. The role exists to own the significant volume of ongoing, business-as-usual regulatory work that currently falls to a small group of very senior lawyers – freeing them to focus on strategic licensing initiatives, complex transactions, and team leadership. You will operate as a practical legal generalist with focus on: Product advice covering Payward’s growing offerings in the EU and UK (Krak card, payments and staking, among other things) Cryptoasset Regime Compliance (under MiCA/EU or in the UK) — advising on regulatory obligations for CASPs including supporting on the steady flow of regulatory queries, notifications and supervisory correspondence that keeps our licensed entities compliant and our regulatory relationships strong; and Payments & e-money compliance — advising on regulatory obligations affecting our e-money and payment accounts and supporting related workstreams as they arise. We’re looking for a hands-on lawyer with strong regulatory fluency and a track record of independently owning BAU regulatory relationships (ideally honed in the regulated financial sector). This is a fully remote role for a qualified lawyer in the UK or EU. The opportunity Provide legal support on cryptoasset, e-money and payment services regulatory requirements, including advising on account-access obligations and related operational compliance questions Support the team’s active licensing applications and other in-flight EU/UK licensing or registration workstreams, including compiling application materials and coordinating with outside counsel Provide regulatory support on corporate transactions and structural changes affecting EU/UK entities (e.g., change-of-control notifications, corporate client migrations) Support the day-to-day relationship with regulators for our licensed entities Translate complex regulatory frameworks (e.g., MiCA and the UK Cryptoasset Regime, CBI and FCA rulebooks, AML/CTF, DORA, outsourcing requirements, and e-money and payment services regulation) into pragmatic, actionable guidance for the business Foster a culture of clarity, favouring plain-English communication, measurable risk tradeoffs, and decision-ready recommendations What you bring Qualified lawyer (Solicitor/Barrister of England & Wales, Irish Solicitor/Barrister, or equivalent admitted in an EU Member State) 10+ years’ post-qualification experience (PQE) in financial services regulatory law gained at a regulated financial services institution (e.g., a bank, payment institution, broker-dealer, exchange, or crypto services provider) or in a law firm/private practice supporting such clients, with demonstrated ability to independently own BAU regulatory workstreams Direct experience supporting regulator engagement (e.g., with the CBI, FCA, or an equivalent EU competent authority), including notifications, information requests, and supervisory correspondence Substantive experience advising on MiCA or the UK Cryptoasset Regime (i.e., FCA authorisation for regulated cryptoasset activities under the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Cryptoassets) Regulations 2026) — experience with one regime is sufficient; both is not required Substantive experience with e-money and payment services regulation in the EU or UK (experience in one jurisdiction is sufficient; both is not required), including account-access and open banking obligations Experience in AML/CTF (anti-money laundering / counter-terrorist financing), including advising on related policies, controls, and regulatory expectations Experience advising on outsourcing arrangements and operational resilience compliance (e.g., Digital Operational Resilience Act in the EU, or the FCA/PRA operational resilience regime in the UK) Outstanding analytical, drafting, and organisational skills with crisp, plain-English writing Ability to efficiently and confidently distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyer stakeholders Pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that prioritises providing stakeholders with a useful range of options and clear recommendations Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and owning a broad, fast-moving BAU workload from day one Nice to haves Familiarity with MiFID II and its application to investment services, including derivatives, equities, and emerging tokenised financial instruments Experience supporting change-of-control notifications or other regulatory aspects of corporate transactions An authentic interest in crypto and digital assets, and familiarity with Payward’s and competitors’ products Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Our commitment Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. title: Security Analytics Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.</p></div><p><span style="color: rgb(31, 56, 100); font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Job description</strong></span></p> <p style="color: !important;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The successful candidate will join the Security Data Analytics team, working across PlayStation data assets and business groups. This team develops the data products, pipelines, dashboards, and reporting that help Information Security teams understand security posture, risk trends, control effectiveness, exposure, and remediation progress.  Our work is increasingly built on automation and AI-enabled analytics, and this role builds the data foundations that make that possible.</span></p> <p style="color: !important;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This opening focuses on the backend of that work.  Reporting to the Director of Security Data Analytics, you will design and operate the data engineering foundations our analytics depend on: ingestion and transformation pipelines, Snowflake data models, automation, and the enrichment and AI-ready data patterns that turn raw security signals into trusted, analytics-ready data. Presentation-layer engineers own most visualization delivery, so your primary contribution is the reliability, structure, and performance of the data layer, including keeping it running day to day.</span></p> <p style="color: !important;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This is a technical, individual contributor role.  You will solve moderately complex problems with limited supervision and own a discrete workstream or a sub-set of a larger effort, working closely with a global set of stakeholders.  This role is UK-based and remote-eligible.</span></p> <p style="color: !important;"><span style="color: rgb(31, 56, 100); font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Design, build, and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and enrichment pipelines that turn security, technology, and business data into trusted, analytics-ready data.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Build and maintain Snowflake data models and warehouse objects that support reporting, visualization, automation, and AI-enabled use cases.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Develop automation that reduces manual data handling and reporting effort and improves reliability across the platform.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Prepare AI-ready data and support AI-enabled analytics and reasoning workflows built on our data platform.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Add business and technical context to security data to improve prioritization and decision-making.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Apply software engineering practices to data and analytics code, including version control, testing, code review, and CI.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Run and support the team's pipelines and data products in production: monitor health, respond to failures, and troubleshoot and resolve ingestion and pipeline issues to keep data flowing reliably.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Partner with global stakeholders across security, IT, studio, platform, and engineering teams to translate requirements into reliable data and reporting.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Document data models, pipelines, and solutions so the team can support them.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Share knowledge with teammates and contribute to team projects as priorities shift.</span></li> </ul> <p style="color: !important;"><span style="color: rgb(31, 56, 100); font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Qualifications</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">4+ years creating analytics, reporting, data engineering, or data platform solutions.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Hands-on SQL and strong knowledge of database technologies (relational, columnar, or NoSQL).</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Hands-on experience with Snowflake, our primary data platform.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience building data pipelines and applying data modeling concepts for analytics or data warehouse use cases.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience operating data pipelines in production: monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving ingestion and pipeline failures.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience with scripting and automation (Python, Java, R, or similar).</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience preparing data for, or supporting, AI-enabled analytics or machine learning workflows.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience with REST APIs, common data formats (JSON, XML), and platform SDKs or APIs.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Software engineering practices for analytics code: version control, testing, and CI.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience with large, complex data sets; security, technology, risk, or compliance data a plus.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience partnering with cross-functional teams, with clear written and verbal communication about data and technical tradeoffs.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Some travel may be required.</span></li> </ul> <p style="color: !important;"><span style="color: rgb(31, 56, 100); font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Desired qualifications</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Advanced Snowflake features, such as tasks, streams, dynamic tables, and performance tuning.</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience with dbt or a similar title: Strategy Director, Media Strategy
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3078 - Strategy Director, Media Strategy - UK</strong></p> <p>We're seeking a strategic thinker with expertise in media effectiveness and storytelling to join our team at T&P. Your role will involve shaping client communications through insightful strategies, fostering innovation, and maintaining effective measurement processes.</p> <p>This role will include one of our integrated clients and the successful candidate will be the senior strategy practitioner. As such, it is ideally suited for a strategist who is keen to develop a broader skillset than media alone, as well as gain experience managing senior client stakeholders.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Whilst your average to do list will vary from day to day, typical responsibilities will include:</p> <ul> <li>Leading strategic responses, narratives for pitches as well as delivering genuine data-driven insight to client teams</li> <li>Delivering key internal strategic workstreams, planning and insight training as well as encouraging agency creativity and innovation</li> <li>Present work in agency forums, lead agency brainstorms as well as identify and develop award entries</li> <li>Staying up to date with trends and sharing this with strategy teams alongside contributing to thought pieces and external events</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>We are most interested in your ability to articulate the client’s challenge succinctly and turn that into actionable instructions for media planning teams. The skillset and experience you may have had to get to this point may vary but in general will include:</li> <ul> <li>Both ATL and Digital media channel knowledge</li> <li>The gravitas to be a trusted strategic partner to key clients</li> <li>Ability to build strong relationships across the agency</li> <li>Understanding of effectiveness best practice and a willing to improvise to deliver competitive advantage</li> <li>Most importantly, you will be curious, clear and creative in your thinking, writing and speaking.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.</p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3594 - Director, Planning - UK</strong></p> <p><strong> Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>The planning team are the guardians of creating industry leading, unrivalled work at Wavemaker. We are central conduits to all specialists, striving to push boundaries and have a positive impact on consumers and brand.</p> <p>Wavemaker UK is looking for a Director, Planning to join our growing planning team, to drive forward our planning output and help to create amazing work for our clients.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <p><strong>Media Planning Craft: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the Wavemaker planning output on your specific client to create unrivalled work.</li> <li>Be able to articulate the strategic approach into media behaviours and train and support the wider team.</li> <li>Need strategic thinking on how we utilise tools and specialism outside of planning on response i.e. sources of growth, measurement, learning agenda, data, etc</li> <li>Build presence outside of current teams and drive visibility of planning team within the wider agency.</li> <li>Bring a fresh perspective to planning approaches including the use of different tools, new insights and coach others to challenge the status quo.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Effective communication:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Overall responsibility for the development of all planning responses, ensuring we are developing unrivalled work in all executions.</li> <li>Manage senior client relationships, understanding what they need for their business and how to drive growth for them.</li> <li>Manage the planning team ensuring the have clear personal objectives, structure and regular reviews.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Idea creation and storytelling: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and develop relationship with media owners and look for opportunities to create unrivalled work</li> <li>Have an advanced commercial understanding of Wavemakers products and services. Understanding which are suitable for their clients and how sell in solutions.</li> <li>Be a story telling expert, driving added value with the team and quality boosting output.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Practice Area Knowledge – Advanced- </strong>Demonstrates advanced understanding of the industry as well as future trends Serves as an internal consultant/expert on at least some tools and technology.</p> <p>Effectively guides junior team members on advanced elements.</p> <p>Works with leadership team to develop new solutions and/or spot new applications</p> <p><strong>Problem Solving – Advanced -</strong> Performs complex analyses of a range of information and identifies issues before they become problems; helps others think about how to define or redefine complex problems. Supports business leaders to find solutions and evaluates others’ solutions to determine the best way forward. Understand how to resolve escalated issues and coaches others to problem solve. Manages escalations.</p> <p><strong>Stakeholder Management – Advanced - </strong>Capitalizes on deep understanding of (current or potential) client and agency organizational structures, business processes, strategic objectives and challenges in order to anticipate and meet their needs. Demonstrates expert knowledge and monitors the client’s industry and competitive environment in order to create effective solutions. Advises key stakeholders by continuously helping them to successfully navigate through critical business changes.​​​​​​​ Uses strong deep expertise and contextual awareness to explore complex issues with stakeholders and provide trusted advice, deliverables and campaign KPIs.</p> <p><strong>Effective Communication – Advanced - </strong>Leads the delivery of relevant and accurate information to drive maximum impact. Consistently delivers communications to influence and educate all levels of seniority, appropriately judging the demands of the situation. Creatively develops presentations and comms to help with the understanding/education of complex information. Guides others on the best practices and approaches for creating clear, concise and organized communication materials to convey plans in a user-friendly way.</p> <p><strong>Campaign Management – Expert -</strong> Sets the standard for accuracy and thoroughness so that sufficiently detailed information is logged correctly.  Balances short-term considerations with long-term goals and ensures that critical deliverables are met.  Manages multiple overlapping timelines and competing demands, weighing the needs of different stakeholders across the business to determine priorities for parallel projects and sets priorities according to business needs.</p> <p><strong>Compelling storytelling – Advanced -</strong> Lead and direct the creation of a story, taking into account client knowledge levels and needs. Applies deep expertise and sound judgement to persuade key decision makers on recommendation, considering all implications. Designs differentiated communications (content focus, style, presentation, etc.) for various internal and external audiences.</p> <p><strong>Ideas Creation – Expert - </strong>Develops strategies to bring new technologies, innovations and products to life.  Challenges the client and team in innovating and designing new solutions, methods and products to remain competitive and lead the industry.</p> <p><strong>Comms Planning – Advanced -</strong> High technical knowledge of all media touchpoints as well as how they interplay and future trends.  Serves as a consultant and quality controls plans, strategies and frameworks that leave the building.  Strategic learnings and insights about business impact (not just media metrics).  Development of directional media strategy/platform.  Developing comms planning skills amongst wider community.  Looks for alternative solutions to problems and constantly challenges received norms in a spirit of positive provocation.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Life at WPP Media & Benefits</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. title: Head of Risk Operations
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale. Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us. Attributes We Value We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next. About the team: Risk Operations is a global 1LOD team responsible for the Acquiring, Issuing and Credit Risk domains. The team handles cases and investigations across product domains, working closely with 2LOD and Commercial teams to ensure that Airwallex operates within its risk appetite. The team is passionate about operational excellence and delivering an exceptional end-to-end customer experience. What you’ll do: As the Senior Director/Head of Risk Operations, you will lead a global team responsible for defining procedures and delivering operational excellence across new client onboarding, periodic review and in-life behaviour. You will ensure that Airwallex champions high standards for integrity, judgement and documentation in all aspects of risk operations. Responsibilities: Own the vision, strategy and execution for Risk Operations Build, lead and develop high-performing a globally distributed team Own the location and resourcing strategy of the team, solving for 24/7 coverage, quality of customer experience and cost efficiency Create a repeatable & scalable operating rhythm, including clear OKRs Take a data-driven approach to performance management Strike the right balance between risk, customer experience and commercial impact, ensuring timely, high-quality decision making and communications Drive continuous improvement in the quality of procedures, playbooks and control frameworks, aligned to Airwallex financial crime and fraud policies defined by 2LOD and partnering closely with Risk Product and Engineering Ensure that Airwallex continues to improve the quality and consistency of documentation Lead AI transformation of the Risk Operations team This role will be based in either London or Singapore. Who are you: We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory. Minimum qualifications: Proven experience, including senior leadership in large-scale, multi-jurisdiction operations in a rapidly growing regulated financial-services or payments/fintech business Proven track record of scaling Risk Operations (at least 2 of Payments, Issuing and Credit) across multiple geographies, and of building globally consistent performance Background in Fraud Ops and ATO risk control Strong commercial and analytical judgement — comfortable framing decisions in unit economics, scalability and return on investment Track record of operating at the Operations–Product–Risk intersection and driving cross-functional outcomes without full reporting-line authority Demonstrated delivery of automation/AI-led transformation in an operations setting Evidence of big data/analytics (including SQL, DBX and BI tooling) Preferred experience: Cross-border payments; multi-entity, multi-licence environments Experience across Payments, Issuing and Credit Risk Comfort with a highly technical, API-first product Exposure to IPO readiness / public-company control environments Top-tier consulting or operator-investor background (structured thinking under ambiguity) Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process.
